versions.content: If the task was aborted due to As, Bs, Cs, Ar, Br, Cr timeout, the CanTp module shall raise the development error CanTp.CANTP_E_RX_COM (in case of a reception operation) or CanTp.CANTP_E_TX_COM (in case of a transmission operation). If the task was aborted due to any other protocol error, the CanTp module shall raise the runtime error code CanTp.CANTP_E_COM to the Default Error Tracer.
